And they want that i should give my earned mony to them i m not doing this so they are angry with me and giving me bad duas plz tell me correct solution can i leave my parents to solve this problem bcz they are not very poor or i should give talaq to my wife for the pleaser of my parents according to that hadeth (dont obey ur parents if they order u to leave ur wife so do it). Answer ID: 3535 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 291/294=L) The cause of anger from parents about your wife mentioned by you is not reasonable; therefore it is not necessary to divorce wife obeying the parents. Yes, if they ask to divorce for some genuine Sharai reason then it is necessary to obey them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
